reasoning: The genuine version records the section 3 supersession of EO 325A as ended on 1974-01-01, the effective date set by section 4, which matches the held text, the clause reason and the savings text. Every other field is identical to the blind version, which I found sound apart from the planted date: identity, the seven-clause inventory, the two held amendments (EO 12608 section 23 and EO 12943) on section 1, and the absence of any held revocation.
